name: – David McAllister – After § 9 – Am 35
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 9e. Recalls that Ukrainian sovereignty must also be safeguarded, with respect to its control of its natural resources, and emphasises that any pressure exerted by transnational companies or foreign governments, such as the United States, or the EU, to gain access to these resources is entirely unacceptable;
